outputs: Text outputs for tasks including title generation, data-to-text conversion, grammar correction, and question rewriting
Generated textual responses evaluated with ROUGE-L
Model generates text outputs for diverse NLP tasks as defined in the Sup-NatInst dataset

changes_made.explanation: Removed tasks not mentioned in the paper (Text Summarization, Paraphrase Generation, Dialogue Generation, Machine Translation). Kept only NLG tasks explicitly listed in evaluation categories. Consolidated duplicate dataset entries.
Normalized ROUGE-L to base ROUGE form according to guidelines. The paper explicitly states ROUGE-L is the evaluation metric.
No evidence of LLM-as-judge evaluation in the paper. The metadata was empty, which is correct.
No evidence of human evaluation in the paper. The paper uses only automatic evaluation (ROUGE-L).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on lifelong in-context instruction learning for natural language generation tasks. It evaluates on 12 categories from Super-NaturalInstructions, but only the NLG tasks (Title Generation, Data to Text, Grammar Error Correction, Question Rewriting) are relevant. The extraction incorrectly included some non-NLG tasks. The paper uses only ROUGE-L for evaluation, with no human or LLM-based evaluation mentioned.
